correctness.rationale: Genus and squarefreeness follow from Kummer/Riemann–Hurwitz and the exact discriminant. In a complete regular-differential basis, Cartier coefficient selection yields P=b(9a^5-b^4), R=6ab^2 and 3b. Semilinear Cartier has rank 0 or 2; its stable rank is 0 for b=0 or P=0 and 2 otherwise. The exceptional P=0 stratum is smooth. Two independent finite-field reconstructions check every F11 parameter pair; symbolic proof covers all algebraically closed parameters. The programs were actually run and produced CARTIER_VERIFY_OK and INDEPENDENT_VERIFY_OK.
